description: Migration dashboard for the legacy -> EKS cutover of Accounts, Keycloak and Stalwart (platform-infrastructure #1536 for stage; reused for prod). Pick the environment with the env variable. Workload replicas, Argo/Kargo state, Stalwart mail flow from logs, Keycloak and Accounts health, blackbox probes, NLB.

panels.description: Available replicas of the stalwart Deployment. 0 is expected between the freeze (W1) and the DB restore (W4).
panels.title: Stalwart available

panels.description: Available replicas of the nginx TCP/HTTP proxy in front of Stalwart (NLB targets).
panels.title: nginx available

panels.description: Ready replicas of the keycloak-customer StatefulSet.
panels.title: Keycloak ready

panels.description: Available replicas of accounts-web (Django).
panels.title: Accounts web available

panels.description: Available replicas of accounts-celery.
panels.title: Accounts celery available

panels.description: Pods in Pending/Failed/Unknown across thundermail, accounts, keycloak-customer.
panels.title: Pods not Running

panels.description: Timeline of the freeze/scale-to-zero and the scale-up. Dashed lines are spec; solid are available/ready.
panels.title: Replicas: spec vs available

panels.description: Argo app state from the shared01 control plane. The freeze PR sets selfHeal=false (not exported as a metric); autosync_enabled shows whether automated sync is on at all.
panels.title: ArgoCD applications

panels.description: Kargo stage health for the Accounts/Keycloak promotion stage and the Stalwart configs deploy stage.
panels.title: Kargo stages

panels.description: W5 gate: the stalwart-config-apply Job must report succeeded=1 after the settings promote.
panels.title: Stalwart config-apply Job succeeded

panels.description: Failed pods of the latest stalwart-config-apply Job.
panels.title: Stalwart config-apply Job failed

panels.description: Restarts across the three namespaces in the last hour (crash loops after the repoint show up here first).
panels.title: Container restarts (1h)

panels.description: Failed/errored sync operations on any ${env}-* Argo application in the last hour.
panels.title: Argo sync failures (1h)

panels.description: Stalwart event queue.queue-message: messages accepted from other MTAs (port 25) in the dashboard time range. This is inbound_since_flip when the range starts at the DNS flip.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(]queue[.]message-queued[)]" | stats () count()

panels.title: Inbound queued

panels.description: Stalwart event queue.queue-message-authenticated: messages submitted by authenticated users (465/587). This is outbound_since_flip.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(]queue[.]authenticated-message-queued[)]" | stats () count()

panels.title: Outbound queued

panels.description: Stalwart event delivery.delivered (per recipient).

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(]delivery[.]delivered[)]" | stats () count()

panels.title: Delivered

panels.description: Stalwart events delivery.failed and delivery.dsn-perm-fail.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(]delivery[.](failed|dsn-perm-fail)[)]" | stats () count()

panels.title: Delivery failed

panels.description: IMAP/SMTP/JMAP logins that succeeded.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(]auth[.]success[)]" | stats () count()

panels.title: Auth successes

panels.description: Failed logins. A burst right after the cutover is expected: every app password and OAuth session has to be re-created.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(]auth[.](failed|error|missing-totp|too-many-attempts|banned)[)]" | stats () count()

panels.title: Auth failures

panels.description: Count of Stalwart log events per subsystem (event name prefix). Protocol traffic resuming after the DNS flip shows up as smtp/imap/jmap.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | extract_regexp "[(](?P<sub>auth|smtp|imap|jmap|pop3|managesieve|dav|queue|delivery|tls|store|http)[.][a-z0-9.-]+[)]" | filter sub:* | stats by (sub) count()

panels.title: Stalwart events by subsystem

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | extract_regexp "^[^ ]+ (?P<lvl>[A-Z]+) " | stats by (lvl) count()

cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(]auth[.][a-z-]+[)]" | extract_regexp "[(](?P<event>auth[.][a-z-]+)[)]" | stats by (event) count()

cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"[(](queue|delivery)[.][a-z-]+[)]" | extract_regexp "[(](?P<event>(queue|delivery)[.][a-z-]+)[)]" | stats by (event) count()

cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"^[^ ]+ ERROR " | extract_regexp "[(](?P<event>[a-z0-9.-]+)[)]" | stats by (event) count()

panels.description: JMAP/autoconfig/.well-known traffic through the nginx HTTPS listener. IMAP/SMTP are TCP streams and do not produce access lines.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"nginx" -_msg:~"ELB-HealthChecker" | extract_regexp "HTTP/[0-9.]+\" (?P<status>[0-9]{3}) " | filter status:* | stats by (status) count()

panels.title: nginx HTTP status codes (excl. ELB health checks)

panels.description: ERROR lines in the selected range (same filter as the log panel beside it). 0 means the log panel's "No data" is genuinely quiet.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"^[^ ]+ ERROR " -_msg:~"http[.]x-forwarded-missing" | stats () count()

panels.title: Stalwart errors (range)

panels.description: WARN lines in the selected range (same filter as the log panel beside it). 0 means the log panel's "No data" is genuinely quiet.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"^[^ ]+ WARN " -_msg:~"http[.]x-forwarded-missing" | stats () count()

panels.title: Stalwart warnings (range)

panels.description: x-forwarded-missing warnings (local health checks on :8080) are filtered out.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | filter _msg:~"^[^ ]+ (ERROR|WARN) " -_msg:~"http[.]x-forwarded-missing" | sort by (_time) desc limit 300

panels.title: Stalwart errors and warnings

panels.description: HTTP 5xx responses from Keycloak in the last 5 minutes (health/metrics endpoints excluded).
panels.title: Keycloak 5xx (5m)

panels.description: Keycloak event log lines with type=LOGIN_ERROR over the dashboard range.
panels.title: Login errors (log events, range)

panels.description: Successful password validations. Keycloak only logs *_ERROR events at the current log level, so successful LOGIN events never reach VictoriaLogs. Does not count federated/SSO logins.
panels.title: Logins (valid password checks, range)

panels.description: Password hash validations in the last 5 minutes: a direct proxy for sign-in attempts against the realm.
panels.title: Password validations (5m)

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"keycloak-customer" container:"keycloak" level:error | stats () count()

panels.description: All Keycloak HTTP responses except health and metrics scrapes.
panels.title: Keycloak requests by status

panels.description: OIDC auth, token, login-actions, userinfo and logout endpoints by status. Token traffic from Accounts/Appointment resuming is the sign-in proof after the repoint.
panels.title: Keycloak auth flow requests

panels.description: Mean response time per realm endpoint (no histogram buckets are exported). A slow Neon connection after the repoint shows up here.
panels.title: Keycloak mean latency by endpoint

panels.description: Keycloak event log (LOGIN, LOGIN_ERROR, CODE_TO_TOKEN, USER_INFO_REQUEST_ERROR...).

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"keycloak-customer" container:"keycloak" _msg:~"org.keycloak.events" | extract_regexp "type=\"(?P<type>[A-Z_]+)\"" | filter type:* | stats by (type) count()

panels.title: Keycloak event types (logs)

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"keycloak-customer" container:"keycloak" (level:error OR level:warn) | sort by (_time) desc limit 300

panels.description: 5xx responses logged by accounts-web (uvicorn access lines; the / health check is excluded).

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:"accounts" _msg:~"HTTP/1[.][01]\" [0-9]{3}" -_msg:~"\"GET / HTTP" | extract_regexp "HTTP/1[.][01]\" (?P<status>[0-9]{3})" | filter status:~"5.." | stats () count()

panels.title: Accounts HTTP 5xx (range)

panels.description: Non-health-check requests logged by accounts-web.

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:"accounts" _msg:~"HTTP/1[.][01]\" [0-9]{3}" -_msg:~"\"GET / HTTP" | stats () count()

panels.title: Accounts HTTP requests (range)

panels.description: Error-level lines from accounts-web, accounts-celery and accounts-flower.
panels.title: Accounts error log lines (range)

panels.description: Accounts errors mentioning Stalwart (quota lookups, app-password create/delete). The W5 gate requires app-password create + delete to return 2xx.
panels.title: Stalwart admin errors from Accounts (range)

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:"accounts-celery" _msg:~"raised unexpected|Task .* FAILURE|ERROR/" | stats () count()
cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:"accounts-celery" _msg:~"succeeded in" | stats () count()

cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:"accounts" _msg:~"HTTP/1[.][01]\" [0-9]{3}" -_msg:~"\"GET / HTTP" | extract_regexp "HTTP/1[.][01]\" (?P<status>[0-9]{3})" | filter status:* | stats by (status) count()
cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:in("accounts","accounts-celery","accounts-flower") | stats by (container, level) count()

panels.title: Accounts log lines by level and container

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:in("accounts","accounts-celery","accounts-flower") (level:error OR _msg:~"Traceback|Internal Server Error") | sort by (_time) desc limit 300

panels.title: External reachability (blackbox probes; empty until the VMProbe lands)

panels.description: blackbox-exporter probes of the public mail/accounts/auth hosts. Empty until the VMProbe from platform-infrastructure #1545 is deployed. Downtime is the span where mail./accounts./auth. are DOWN.
panels.title: Probe success

panels.description: Number of times the resolved IP changed in the last 10 minutes: shows the mail. CNAME flip to the new NLB propagating.
panels.title: DNS answer changed (10m)

panels.description: Pod phases across the three namespaces. Pending pods after the scale-up usually mean a missing Secret (ESO) or a node scale-up in progress.
panels.title: Pods by phase
NLB healthy targets by target group
NLB unhealthy targets by target group
AWS NLB (CloudWatch; AccessDenied until the grafana-cloudwatch role gets cloudwatch:GetMetricData)

targets.expr: cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"stalwart" | replace_regexp ("\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m", "") at _msg | sort by (_time) desc limit 500
cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"keycloak-customer" container:"keycloak" | sort by (_time) desc limit 500
cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"accounts" container:in("accounts","accounts-celery","accounts-flower") | sort by (_time) desc limit 500
cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" container:"nginx" -_msg:~"ELB-HealthChecker" | sort by (_time) desc limit 500
cluster:"mzla-eks-${env}01" namespace:"thundermail" pod:~"stalwart-config-apply.*" | sort by (_time) desc limit 500
